label: Atypical haemolytic uraemic syndrome
summary: An integrated aHUS map connecting inherited and acquired complement dysregulation, endothelial and platelet injury, microvascular thrombosis, haemolysis, thrombocytopenia and kidney dysfunction. Includes heme amplification and C5 targets; study-specific limits and disputed THBD genetics remain explicit.
